🖥️ How WebPilot (or any headless browser plug-in) handles JavaScript

WebPilot (and similar browser-style scrapers) actually spin up a headless Chromium instance behind the scenes.

That means when a website requires client-side rendering (React, Angular, Vue, etc.), it can execute the JavaScript, build the DOM, and then scrape the rendered HTML.

It can also simulate things like scrolling, clicking buttons, waiting for dynamic content.
